goal: Prove read-only whether the HGB Depreciation Book Card exposes concrete values for G/L Integration - Acq. Cost and, if possible, G/L Integration - Depreciation before any depreciation journal preflight.

unlockedBy.decision: Do not unlock depreciation preflight until HGB G/L Integration values are proven, not just captions/context.

acceptanceCriteria: The run stays in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
The HGB Depreciation Book Card or Page Inspection context is opened read-only.
The result clearly classifies whether G/L Integration - Acq. Cost value is proven, not just caption-visible.
No journal line, Preview Posting, posting, setup change or company switch occurs.
If value is still not readable, the blocker is documented without unlocking depreciation preflight.
stopConditions: Business Central shows a different instance or company.
The path would require editing/toggling setup values.
A dialog asks to confirm a write, setup, preview or posting action.
The test cannot distinguish caption visibility from value proof.
nextSafeAction: FIXEDASSETS-232: local decision for the smallest safe depreciation preflight; no journal, no preview and no posting until explicitly unlocked.

lastResult.summary: FA-231 proved G/L Integration - Acq. Cost as visible-on read-only; no setup, preview or posting occurred.
